translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tongguang Zhuangzong entered Bian and summoned Qing; delighted to see him, Zhuangzong made him prefect of Weizhou and gave him the titles of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Acting Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 明宗朝，授衍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the Mingzong reign he was made prefect of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under Mingzong he was appointed prefect of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 長興中，檢校太傅、右神武統軍。

translations.literal: In the Changxing era he was Acting Grand Tutor and commander of the Right Divine Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: During Changxing he served as Acting Grand Tutor and commander of the Right Divine Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 高祖即位之二年，加特進、檢校太尉、右領軍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year after the High Ancestor took the throne he was given Special Advancement, Acting Grand Commandant, and Grand General of the Right Army Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Gaozu's reign he was given Special Advancement, Acting Grand Commandant, and Grand General of the Right Army Guard.

sentences.zh: 三年，進封開國伯。

translations.literal: In the third year he was advanced to the title Earl Who Establishes the State.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was enfeoffed as Earl Who Establishes the State.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷左領軍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to the post of Grand General of the Left Army Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he became Grand General of the Left Army Guard.

sentences.zh: 尋以病卒，年七十。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died of illness, aged seventy.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died of illness at the age of seventy.

sentences.zh: 制贈太師。

translations.literal: By edict he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: The court posthumously honored him as Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 頃性溫雅，不暴虐，凡刺郡統眾，頗有畏愛，及卒，人甚惜之。

translations.literal: Qing's nature was mild and refined and not cruel; whenever he governed a prefecture or commanded troops he inspired both fear and affection, and when he died people deeply regretted his loss.
translations.idiomatic: Qing was mild and refined rather than cruel; in every prefecture or command he inspired both respect and affection, and when he died people deeply mourned him.

sentences.zh: 子彥弼，在太原日，因頃走歸梁朝，武皇怒，下蠶室加熏腐之刑，後籍於內侍省，卒焉。

translations.literal: His son Yanbi, while at Taiyuan, because Qing had fled to the Liang court, incurred the Martial Emperor's wrath; he was sent to the silkworm chamber and subjected to castration by fumigation, later was registered in the Palace Domestic Service, and died there.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yanbi, while the family was at Taiyuan, was punished because Qing had fled to the Liang: the Martial Emperor in his rage sent him to the castration ward and had him emasculated; he was later registered in the Palace Domestic Service and died there.

sentences.zh: 光輔有弟數人，光貞歷義、乾二州刺史，入為諸衛將軍。

translations.literal: Guangfu had several younger brothers; Guangzhen served successively as prefect of Yi and Qian prefectures and entered court as a general of the guard armies.
translations.idiomatic: Guangfu had several younger brothers: Guangzhen served as prefect of Yi and Qian in turn and later became a general of the guard armies at court.

sentences.zh: 光遜繼為蔡州刺史。

translations.literal: Guangxun succeeded to the post and became prefect of Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxun succeeded him as prefect of Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 光贊任青州行軍司馬，及楊光遠叛滅，貶商州司馬，會赦征還，尋卒於家。

translations.literal: Guangzan served as campaign staff officer in Qingzhou; when Yang Guangyuan rebelled and was destroyed he was demoted to staff officer of Shangzhou; when an amnesty was proclaimed he was recalled, and soon died at home.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzan served as campaign staff officer in Qingzhou; when Yang Guangyuan's rebellion was crushed he was demoted to staff officer of Shangzhou; recalled under an amnesty, he soon died at home.

sentences.zh: 符彥饒，唐莊宗朝蕃漢總管存審之第二字也。

translations.literal: Fu Yanrao was the second son by name of Cunjian, the overall tribal-and-Han commander of the Tang Zhuangzong court.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanrao was the second son of Li Cunjian, the overall commander of tribal and Han forces under Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang.

sentences.zh: 存審，《唐書》有傳。

translations.literal: Cunjian has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.
translations.idiomatic: His father Cunjian is given a full biography in the 《Book of Tang》.

sentences.zh: 彥饒少驍勇，能騎射。

translations.literal: Yanrao in youth was valiant and brave and skilled in riding and archery.
translations.idiomatic: In youth Yanrao was bold and skilled in riding and archery.

sentences.zh: 唐天祐十五年冬，莊宗與梁大戰於胡柳陂，彥饒與弟彥圖俱從其父血戰，有功，莊宗壯之，因用為騎將。

translations.literal: In winter of the fifteenth year of Tang Tianyou, Zhuangzong fought a great battle with Liang at Huliupo; Yanrao and his younger brother Yantu both followed their father in bloody combat with merit; Zhuangzong admired this and therefore employed him as a cavalry officer.
translations.idiomatic: In winter of Tianyou 15 Zhuangzong fought a great battle with the Liang at Huliupo; Yanrao and his brother Yantu fought alongside their father with distinction; Zhuangzong was impressed and made Yanrao a cavalry officer.

sentences.zh: 同光中，以功授曹州刺史。

translations.literal: In the Tongguang era, for merit he was made prefect of Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: During Tongguang he was made prefect of Caozhou for his service.

sentences.zh: 明宗即位，改刺沂州。

translations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne he was transferred to govern Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong took the throne he was transferred to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 天成中，屯守梁園，會起軍北戍塞下，時有偏校以宣武之帥，迫彥饒為之，彥饒紿許其請，明日，殺為惡者奏之，時人嘉其方略。

translations.literal: In the Tiancheng era he was garrisoned at Liangyuan; when troops were raised to guard the northern frontier, a deputy officer used the commander of Xuanwu to force Yanrao to act for him; Yanrao pretended to agree, and the next day killed the ringleader and reported it—people of the time praised his stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: During Tiancheng he was garrisoned at Liangyuan; when troops were mobilized for the northern frontier, a deputy officer tried to use the Xuanwu commander to force Yanrao to join a plot; Yanrao feigned agreement, then the next day killed the ringleader and reported him—contemporaries praised his shrewdness.

sentences.zh: 長興中，為金州防禦使，為政甚有民譽，其後略遷節鎮。

translations.literal: In the Changxing era he was defense commissioner of Jinzhou; his governance won great popular esteem, and afterward he was gradually transferred among military governorships.
translations.idiomatic: During Changxing he was defense commissioner of Jinzhou and governed with a strong reputation among the people; he was later transferred among frontier commands.

sentences.zh: 天福初，為滑州節度使，累官至檢校太傅。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu he was military governor of Huazhou and rose in office to Acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianfu he became military governor of Huazhou and rose to Acting Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，範延光據鄴都叛，朝廷遣侍衛馬軍都指揮使白奉進率騎軍三千，屯於州之開元寺。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year Fan Yanguang held Ye in rebellion; the court sent the palace guard cavalry commander Bai Fengjin to lead three thousand horsemen and encamp them at the Kaiyuan Temple in the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year Fan Yanguang rebelled and held Ye; the court sent palace guard cavalry commander Bai Fengjin with three thousand horsemen to encamp at the Kaiyuan Temple in Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 一日，彥饒與奉進因事忿爭於牙署，事具奉進傳中。

translations.literal: One day Yanrao and Fengjin quarreled over a matter in the headquarters office; the affair is fully recorded in Fengjin's biography.
translations.idiomatic: One day Yanrao and Fengjin quarreled over a matter at headquarters; the full account is given in Fengjin's biography.

sentences.zh: 是時，奉進厲聲曰：「爾莫是與範延光同反耶？」

translations.literal: At that time Fengjin said in a harsh voice: "Are you not in rebellion together with Fan Yanguang?"
translations.idiomatic: Fengjin shouted, "Are you not in league with Fan Yanguang's rebellion?"

sentences.zh: 拂衣而起，彥饒不留，帳下介士大噪，擒奉進殺之。

translations.literal: He brushed his robe and rose; Yanrao did not detain him; the guards beneath his tent made a great uproar, seized Fengjin, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: He turned to leave; Yanrao did not stop him, but his guards raised an uproar, seized Fengjin, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 奉進從騎散走，傳呼於外。

translations.literal: Fengjin's escort horsemen scattered and fled, crying the news outside.
translations.idiomatic: Fengjin's escort scattered and fled, spreading word of what had happened outside.

sentences.zh: 時步軍都校馬萬、次校盧順密聞奉進被害，即率其部眾攻滑之子城，執彥饒以出。

translations.literal: At the time the infantry commander Ma Wan and deputy commander Lu Shunmi, hearing that Fengjin had been killed, immediately led their troops to attack the inner city of Huazhou, seized Yanrao, and brought him out.
translations.idiomatic: Infantry commander Ma Wan and deputy commander Lu Shunmi, hearing that Fengjin had been killed, at once led their troops against the inner city of Huazhou, seized Yanrao, and brought him out.

sentences.zh: 遣裨校方太拘送闕下，行及赤岡南，高祖遣中使害於路左。

translations.literal: They sent deputy officer Fang Tai to escort him to court; when they reached south of Chigang, the High Ancestor dispatched a palace envoy to kill him on the roadside.
translations.idiomatic: They sent deputy officer Fang Tai to escort him to the capital; south of Chigang the High Ancestor sent a palace envoy to execute him on the road.

sentences.zh: 羅周敬，字尚素，鄴王紹威之弟三子也。

translations.literal: Luo Zhoujing, style name Shangsu, was the third son of Prince Ye Shaowei.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Zhoujing, whose courtesy name was Shangsu, was the third son of Prince of Ye Shaowei.

sentences.zh: 紹威，《梁書》有傳。

translations.literal: Shaowei has a biography in the 《Book of Liang》.
translations.idiomatic: Shaowei has a biography in the 《Book of Liang》.

sentences.zh: 周敬幼聰明，八歲學為詩，往往傳於人口，起家授檢校尚書、禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: Zhoujing was clever from childhood; at eight he began to study poetry, and his verses often passed from mouth to mouth; upon entering service he was given Acting Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Vice Director of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Zhoujing was clever from childhood; at eight he began writing poetry, and his verses were often on people's lips; upon entering service he received the titles of Acting Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Vice Director of Rites.

sentences.zh: 梁乾化中，以兄周翰節制滑臺，卒於官，乃以周敬繼之，命為兩使留後，尋正授旄鉞，時年十歲。

translations.literal: In the Liang Ganhuo era his elder brother Zhouhan governed Huatai and died in office; Zhoujing was then made his successor, appointed acting military governor of both circuits, and soon given the full commission—he was ten years old at the time.
translations.idiomatic: During the Liang Ganhuo era his elder brother Zhouhan governed Huazhou and died in office; Zhoujing succeeded him as acting military governor and soon received the full commission—he was ten years old at the time.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改授許州節度使，繼加檢校尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to military governor of Xuzhou and further given Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to military governor of Xuzhou and given the additional title of Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 逾三年，征授秘書監、檢校司空、駙馬都尉，尚梁普安公主，旋移光祿卿。

translations.literal: After more than three years he was summoned and made Director of the Secretariat, Acting Minister of Works, and Commander of the Imperial Sons-in-Law; he married Princess Pu'an of Liang and was soon transferred to Director of the Imperial Banquets.
translations.idiomatic: After three years he was summoned to court as Director of the Secretariat, Acting Minister of Works, and Commander of the Imperial Sons-in-Law; he married Princess Pu'an of Liang and was soon made Director of the Imperial Banquets.

sentences.zh: 莊宗即位，歷左右金吾大將軍。

translations.literal: When Zhuangzong took the throne he served successively as Grand General of the Left and Right Golden Crow Armies.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong took the throne he served in turn as Grand General of the Left and Right Golden Crow Armies.

sentences.zh: 初，唐天祐中，紹威嘗建第於洛陽福善裏，及莊宗入洛，以梁租庸使趙巖宅賜明宗。

translations.literal: Earlier, in Tang Tianyou, Shaowei had built a mansion in Fushan Lane in Luoyang; when Zhuangzong entered Luoyang he gave the residence of the Liang commissioner for rent and corvée Zhao Yan to Mingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, during Tang Tianyou, Shaowei had built a mansion in Fushan Lane in Luoyang; when Zhuangzong entered Luoyang he gave Mingzong the residence of the Liang rent-and-corvée commissioner Zhao Yan.

sentences.zh: 同光中，明宗在洛，以趨內稍遠，乃召周敬議易其第，周敬諾之。

translations.literal: In the Tongguang era Mingzong was in Luoyang; because the journey to the palace was somewhat far, he summoned Zhoujing to discuss exchanging residences, and Zhoujing agreed.
translations.idiomatic: During Tongguang Mingzong was in Luoyang; finding the ride to court somewhat long, he asked Zhoujing to exchange residences, and Zhoujing agreed.

sentences.zh: 後明宗即位，一日夢中見一人，儀形瑰秀，若素識者，夢中問曰：「此得非前宅主羅氏子？」

translations.literal: Later, when Mingzong took the throne, one day in a dream he saw a man of splendid and handsome bearing who seemed someone he had long known; in the dream he asked: "Could this not be the son of the Luo family, the former owner of the house?"
translations.idiomatic: Later, after Mingzong took the throne, he dreamed one day of a man of splendid bearing who seemed familiar; in the dream he asked, "Could this be the son of the Luo family, the former owner of the house?"

sentences.zh: 及寤，訪其子孫，左右對曰：「周敬見列明廷。」

translations.literal: When he awoke he inquired after his descendants; attendants replied: "Zhoujing is now at court in the bright hall."
translations.idiomatic: When he awoke he asked after the family's descendants; his attendants replied, "Zhoujing is now at court."

sentences.zh: 召至，果符夢中所見。

translations.literal: He was summoned, and indeed matched what had been seen in the dream.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned, and indeed matched the man in the dream.

sentences.zh: 明宗謂侍臣曰：「朕不欲使大勛之後久無土地。」

translations.literal: Mingzong said to his attendants: "I do not wish the descendants of great merit to long go without lands."
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong told his attendants, "I do not wish the descendants of great merit to remain landless for long."

sentences.zh: 因授同州節度使，加檢校太保。

translations.literal: He therefore made him military governor of Tongzhou and added Acting Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore appointed him military governor of Tongzhou and gave him the additional title of Acting Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 長興中，入為左監門衛上將軍，四遷諸衛上將軍。

translations.literal: In the Changxing era he entered court as Grand General of the Left Gate Guard Army and was transferred four times among the grand generals of the guard armies.
translations.idiomatic: During Changxing he entered court as Grand General of the Left Gate Guard Army and was transferred four times among the guard army commands.

sentences.zh: 天福二年卒，時年三十二。

translations.literal: He died in the second year of Tianfu, aged thirty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Tianfu at the age of thirty-two.

sentences.zh: 贈太傅。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor.
